# Code of Conduct

This project is intended to be a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative space for everyone involved.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and professional in all interactions.
- Be constructive when giving feedback.
- Assume good intent and focus on the issue, not the person.
- Avoid harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, or disruptive behavior.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, abuse, or hateful language.
- Deliberate intimidation or trolling.
- Sharing private information without permission.
- Any conduct that makes participation unsafe or unwelcome.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit, or refuse contributions and participation that violate this code of conduct.
If you experience or observe unacceptable behavior, please report it through the repository’s normal project contact channel.
